# LZO 2.10 safe LZO2A decoder

Unmodified build dependency subset of LZO 2.10 (2017-03-01), by Markus F.X.J.
Oberhumer. Upstream: https://www.oberhumer.com/opensource/lzo/

License: GPL-2.0-or-later; see COPYING and the individual file headers. Only
`lzo2a_decompress_safe` is compiled, including input, output and lookbehind
bounds checks. Used to read the owner's AC II archives locally. No game assets
are distributed. Include this source and license in source releases.
